releaseName: A first look before you type
notes: New visitors now land on a worked example — real payoff date, real interest saved, a live chart — instead of a screen of zeros. It is clearly marked as an example, nothing about it is saved, and one tap on "Start with my numbers" clears it and takes you to the form.

The Dashboard now opens straight onto your figures — the old "Debt Command Center" heading and tagline have been removed, so on a phone you see your numbers immediately instead of scrolling past a title.
The app name in the top bar now reads "DebtFree Dashboard" and takes up less room.
Corrected the wording of the first-run privacy note so it accurately describes how your balances are handled: they stay on your device and are never sent to our servers.
